summary: Run sheets for BW24_0253 (Avernelwick Pharmaceuticals Ltd, AP02 aminopyrimidine regioisomer series 02): liver microsomal clearance and human plasma protein binding for 18 compounds. The first equilibrium-dialysis run had low recovery and was repeated with revised labware; the repeat is the reportable free-fraction ranking. Accepted 26 August 2024.

rows.v: Brindlewythe Biosciences Ltd, a Tarnovell company
BW24_0253 run sheets: AP02 microsomal clearance and dialysis recovery

rows: Liver microsomal stability; plasma protein binding (RED)
Low dialysis recovery confounded the first binding run. The repeat with revised labware gave an interpretable free-fraction ranking.
